CompleteOrderedFieldIntegerPrimeEmbeddin.label: def:auto:19.7.1.2
CompleteOrderedFieldIntegerPrimeEmbeddin.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] \\IntegerPrimeEmbeddingLaws {\\theta _{\\mathbb Z}}\\coloneqq {}& \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(\\IntZero )=0_K\\land \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(\\IntOne )=1_K\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall z,w\\in \\mathbb Z\\,\\bigl ( \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z+w)= \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\boxplus \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(zw)= \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\boxtimes \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(-z)=\\boxminus \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\bigl (z<w\\leftrightarrow (\\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\preccurlyeq \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\neq \\theta _{\\mathbb Z}(w))\\bigr )\\bigr ). \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldRationalPrimeEmbeddi.label: def:auto:19.7.1.3
CompleteOrderedFieldRationalPrimeEmbeddi.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] \\RationalPrimeEmbeddingLaws {\\theta _{\\mathbb Q}}\\coloneqq {}& \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(\\RatZero )=0_K\\land \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(\\RatOne )=1_K\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall p,q\\in \\mathbb Q\\,\\bigl ( \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p+q)= \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)\\boxplus \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(pq)= \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)\\boxtimes \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\bigl (p<q\\leftrightarrow (\\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)\\preccurlyeq \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\land \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)\\neq \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(q))\\bigr )\\bigr )\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall p\\in \\mathbb Q\\,\\bigl ( \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(-p)=\\boxminus \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad (p\\neq \\RatZero \\rightarrow \\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p^{-1})= \\operatorname {inv}(\\theta _{\\mathbb Q}(p)))\\bigr ). \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldUniqueness.label: thm:auto:19.7.1.4
CompleteOrderedFieldUniqueness.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes , \\boxminus ,\\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\exists !\\Phi \\colon \\mathbb R\\bij K\\, \\left ( \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\forall x,y\\in \\mathbb R\\, \\bigl (\\Phi (x\\RealAdd y)=\\Phi (x)\\boxplus \\Phi (y)\\bigr )\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall x,y\\in \\mathbb R\\, \\bigl (\\Phi (x\\RealMul y)=\\Phi (x)\\boxtimes \\Phi (y)\\bigr )\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall x,y\\in \\mathbb R\\, \\bigl (x\\RealLe y\\leftrightarrow \\Phi (x)\\preccurlyeq \\Phi (y)\\bigr )\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\Phi (\\RealZero )=0_K\\land \\Phi (\\RealOne )=1_K \\end {aligned} \\right ). \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldNaturalEmbeddingArit.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:1
CompleteOrderedFieldNaturalEmbeddingArit.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\eta _K\\colon \\mathbb N\\to K\\dsep \\eta _K(0)=0_K\\dsep {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\forall n\\in \\mathbb N\\, \\bigl (\\eta _K(n+1)=\\eta _K(n)\\boxplus 1_K\\bigr )\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\forall m,n\\in \\mathbb N\\,\\bigl ( \\eta _K(m+n)=\\eta _K(m)\\boxplus \\eta _K(n)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\eta _K(mn)=\\eta _K(m)\\boxtimes \\eta _K(n)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad (m<n\\leftrightarrow (\\eta _K(m)\\preccurlyeq \\eta _K(n)\\land \\eta _K(m)\\neq \\eta _K(n)))\\bigr ) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldIntegerPrimeEmbeddin.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:2
CompleteOrderedFieldIntegerPrimeEmbeddin.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\exists !\\eta _{\\mathbb Z}\\colon \\mathbb Z\\inj K\\,\\bigl ( \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(\\IntZero )=0_K\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(\\IntOne )=1_K\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\forall z,w\\in \\mathbb Z\\,( \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z+w)= \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\boxplus \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(zw)= \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\boxtimes \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(-z)=\\boxminus \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\land {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad (z<w\\leftrightarrow (\\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\preccurlyeq \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(w)\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(z)\\neq \\eta _{\\mathbb Z}(w))))\\bigr ) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldRationalDense.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:4
CompleteOrderedFieldRationalDense.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep x,y\\in K\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\dsep x\\preccurlyeq y\\dsep x\\neq y\\vdash \\exists q\\in \\mathbb Q\\,\\bigl ({}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad x\\preccurlyeq \\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\land x\\neq \\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\preccurlyeq y\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\neq y\\bigr ) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldSupremumStrictWitnes.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:6
CompleteOrderedFieldSupremumStrictWitnes.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep \\varnothing \\neq S\\subseteq K\\dsep \\UB _{K,\\preccurlyeq }(S)\\neq \\varnothing \\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\dsep \\alpha =\\sup _{K,\\preccurlyeq }(S)\\dsep u\\in K\\dsep u\\preccurlyeq \\alpha \\dsep u\\neq \\alpha \\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\exists s\\in S\\, (u\\preccurlyeq s\\land u\\neq s) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldCutRecovery.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:8
CompleteOrderedFieldCutRecovery.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\Phi (A)\\coloneqq \\sup _{K,\\preccurlyeq }(\\eta _{\\mathbb Q}[A])\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\forall A\\in \\mathbb R\\,\\forall q\\in \\mathbb Q\\, \\Bigl (q\\in A\\leftrightarrow {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad (\\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\preccurlyeq \\Phi (A)\\land \\eta _{\\mathbb Q}(q)\\neq \\Phi (A))\\Bigr ) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldCutSupremumPositiveP.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\CompleteOrderedField {K,\\boxplus ,\\boxtimes ,\\boxminus , \\operatorname {inv},0_K,1_K,\\preccurlyeq }\\dsep \\Phi (A)\\coloneqq \\sup _{K,\\preccurlyeq }(\\eta _{\\mathbb Q}[A])\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\forall A,B\\in \\mathbb R\\, \\bigl ((\\RealZero \\RealLe A\\land \\RealZero \\RealLe B)\\rightarrow {}\\\\[-2pt] &\\qquad \\Phi (A\\RealPosMul B)=\\Phi (A)\\boxtimes \\Phi (B)\\bigr ) \\end {aligned}

CompleteOrderedFieldOrderIsomorphismPres.label: thm:pp:19.7.1.4:14
CompleteOrderedFieldOrderIsomorphismPres.formula: \\begin {aligned}[t] &\\Psi \\colon \\mathbb R\\bij K\\dsep \\forall X,Y\\in \\mathbb R\\, (X\\RealLe Y\\leftrightarrow \\Psi (X)\\preccurlyeq \\Psi (Y))\\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\dsep \\varnothing \\neq S\\subseteq \\mathbb R\\dsep \\UB _{\\mathbb R,\\RealLe }(S)\\neq \\varnothing \\\\[-2pt] &\\quad \\vdash \\Psi (\\sup _{\\mathbb R,\\RealLe }S) =\\sup _{K,\\preccurlyeq }(\\Psi [S]) \\end {aligned}
